metadata.title: Dow up 133 points on gains in shares of Alphabet Inc. Cl A, NVIDIA Corp. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
Dow up 133 points on gains in shares of Alphabet Inc. Cl A, NVIDIA Corp.
Powered by strong returns for shares of Alphabet Inc. Cl A and NVIDIA Corp., the Dow Jones Industrial Average is climbing Thursday morning.
Shares of Alphabet Inc. Cl A Alphabet Inc. Cl A and NVIDIA Corp. NVIDIA Corp. have contributed to the index's intraday rally, as the Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average was most recently trading 133 points, or 0.3%, higher.
